text:
viv: Idea: a low-profile "pulse" rail under the header for first-run users. Shows progress pill, primary CTA, and a horizontal strip of curated sample projects. Aim: keep onboarding visible but not modal-heavy. Mock: https://img.redwood.in/pulse-rail.png omar: Love less interruption. Question: how long does it persist? Should it auto-collapse after inactivity? viv: Plan: show until completed or dismissed, or if user scrolls past header for >10s. Add "Don't show again" option. tai: Accessibility checklist: ensure pill announces progress ("Setup: step 1 of 3"), sample cards are reachable by keyboard with clear focus, and carousel buttons have aria-labels. Avoid focus trap — rail shouldn't steal focus automatically. nora: Contrast: sample card CTA text is 3.0:1 in the mock. Needs to be 4.5:1 or use semi-bold to meet AA. Also nav density: keep rail height <=72px on desktop. omar: Copy suggestions: primary CTA = "Complete setup — 2 steps"; secondary link = "Try sample project". Test variants: A) show step count in pill, B) no step count (simpler). tai: Keyboard behaviour: tabbing into rail should land on the progress pill then to primary CTA then carousel. Arrow keys should navigate cards once focused inside carousel. ESC collapses rail and emits telemetry action=dismiss. viv: Telemetry events: `pulse_rail_impression`, `pulse_rail_cta_click` (cta: complete|sample), `pulse_rail_dismiss`, `pulse_carousel_card_open`. Add `variant: stepcount|nostep` for experiment. nora: Dev snippet: ```
Setup: 1 of 3
Sample A
``` omar: Also ensure the rail is included in keyboard-only screenshots for QA and add a visual focus ring spec. tai: Accessibility note: add `aria-atomic="true"` to the status element so screen readers announce incremental updates. Use `aria-hidden` on decorative images inside cards. viv: Decision: ship pulse rail as anchored strip for the experiment, primary CTA copy = "Complete setup — 2 steps", variant flags as above. Omar will write the telemetry doc, Tai will add ARIA details, Nora will update Figma contrast and heights. ux-bot: create feature flag `pulse_rail_v1`. ux-bot: Feature flag `pulse_rail_v1` created. Figma frame: https://www.figma.com/file/pulse-rail viv: Thanks everyone — please review PR and GH issue #4123. We'll run experiment for 10 days.
